title: Catitude industries
description: Catitude Industries is an industrial-focused Minecraft modpack centered on automation, infrastructure, and long-term progression. It emphasizes building functional factories, transport systems, and power networks rather than shortcuts or magic.
body:
**Catitude Industries** is an industrial-focused Minecraft modpack centered on automation, infrastructure, and long-term progression. It emphasizes building functional factories, transport systems, and power networks rather than shortcuts or magic.

The world is designed to feel alive, with enhanced world generation, improved villages, and meaningful exploration. There are no teleport conveniences; logistics, planning, and cooperation matter.

The pack is built around its core technology mods: Create, Immersive Engineering, Mekanism, Modern Industrialization, PneumaticCraft, and Refined Storage, supported by carefully chosen world generation and quality-of-life mods.

Catitude Industries delivers a serious, cohesive tech experience with a light, distinctive identity.

The long-term goal of Catitude Industries is to run a stable, community-driven FTP-based server by mid-2026, where a fixed number of players can play together simultaneously in a cooperative, PvE-focused environment.
